notes: Skill-creator-format evals for the pipeline protocol. The skill under test IS the SKILL.md text: the WITH arm loads the live skills/pi/planner-executor-pipeline/SKILL.md (+ references/), the WITHOUT arm loads a frozen pre-skill prompt-template snapshot (skill-creator's 'improving an existing skill' baseline). Each eval probes ONE load-bearing protocol rule by asking the model to act as the parent orchestrator on a fixture and observing whether the rule changes the outcome. Read-only analysis tasks deliberately: no subagents are dispatched, so a single `pi -p` arm is a faithful and cheap probe of whether the protocol text steers behaviour. Runner: evals/run-evals.sh. Grader: evals/grade.py (programmatic evidence; a grader still reads both transcripts per agents/grader.md).

evals.name: handoff-contract-shape
assertions: Rejects or flags the node/edge-array `dag` as violating the required mapping shape {"<ticket_id>": [deps]}, rather than accepting it
States that a shape mismatch is returned to the stage as-is (原样退回), not normalised by the parent
Does NOT invent a missing handoff field or fill it in on the subagent's behalf
Requires the handoff to be persisted verbatim (原样落盘) rather than rewritten by the parent

evals.name: gate-authz-before-violation
assertions: Checks `state.authorized_test_edits` BEFORE judging the test diff as a violation
Reaches PASS (authorised-and-recorded) rather than FIX_EXECUTE for the recorded test edit
Records the authorised test modification in gate-evidence
Does not treat an allocated/recorded test change as an unauthorised freeze break

evals.name: bounded-wait-terminal
assertions: Treats an actually expired 24-hour native request as a terminal outcome, not a retry signal
Does not resend the expired request or poll for a reply
Does not emit progress or heartbeat messages while waiting
If the run returns normally after channel expiry, records unresolved questions in blocked_on_interview; does not claim hard stop guarantees a handoff

evals.name: frozen-test-fix-route
assertions: Does NOT route an unauthorised test change to FIX_EXECUTE when the fix itself requires editing the test
Routes instead to REPLAN (contract defect) or HALTED (needs human ruling)
Explains that EXECUTE is forbidden from editing tests, hence FIX_EXECUTE has no legal action
Does not dispatch a repeated empty FIX_EXECUTE task
